## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirmation: overall breadth is constructive but Tech, Industrials and Utilities are weak while Consumer Staples/Materials/Healthcare lead, creating mixed signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Industrials and Technology lag on the week with Industrials hit hard; Industrials: CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -6.86% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION. Technology: ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +24.83%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Style: Mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.58% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.45% | 1M: -9.61%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in semiconductors and select industrial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: EL (1W: +23.46%), FCX (1W: +13.78%), TGT (1W: +12.50%). Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend break rather than broad trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-negative on the week with notable dispersion; MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +27.91%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +8.75% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND contrast with ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: Technology among the 4 lagging sectors this week.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed internals: V (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.69% | 1M: +11.16%) ABOVE TREND while banks show fatigue; JPM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION — Financials currently subdued on the week despite pockets of strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive and defensive-leaning: MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +13.98%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare among the positive groups supporting the cautious regime.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Consumer Staples, Materials and select Healthcare exposure given leadership and confirmed moves in EL, FCX and MRK; reduce exposure to lagging semiconductors and pressured Industrials. Monitor NVDA, ASML and INTC for confirmation or failure of CORRECTION/BEL ow TREND patterns.

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.45% | 1M: -9.61%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (Breadth positive, EL/TGT leading), Healthcare (MRK/LLY strength). BEARISH: Technology (week weakness with megacap dispersion), Industrials (CAT/BA under pressure).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 900 resistance — NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION; AAPL 170 support — AAPL (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -6.73%) RECOVERY; INTC 30 area support — INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND; JPM 180 breakout level — JPM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EL (+55): Estee Lauder margin promise — EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. NOW (+55): AI partnership expansion — NOW (1W: +8.79% | 1M: +29.63%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed. MSFT (+55): backlog resilience — MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +27.91%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-50): China recall headline — TSLA (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +11.47%) ABOVE TREND — negative news diverging from price (watch for follow-through). WMT (-45): rare comp miss — WMT (1W: -6.63% | 1M: -2.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NUE (-45): trade talks pressure — NUE (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND — confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style: Mixed / no clear leadership. EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major divergence among megacaps and semiconductors—NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND and ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND warrant watching for trend breaks.
